system_overview: This is a utility library module providing common helper operators used by the key-value store specifications. It defines reusable operators for set and sequence manipulation, including set intersection, set reduction, sequence reduction, element indexing, sequence-to-set conversion, set permutation generation, and other convenience functions.
actors_and_components: This module has no actors or system components. It is a purely functional library of reusable operators imported by other specification modules in the key-value store project.
additional_assumptions: The module provides the following utility operators: (1) set intersection test (whether two sets overlap), (2) maximum and minimum element selection from a set, (3) generalized set reduction (fold over a set with an accumulator), (4) sequence reduction (fold over a sequence with an accumulator, implemented via a library fold operator), (5) finding the index of an element in a sequence, (6) converting a sequence to the set of its elements, (7) getting the last element of a sequence, (8) testing if a sequence is empty, (9) removing all occurrences of an element from a sequence, (10) computing the intersection of a set of sets, (11) generating all permutation sequences of a finite set, and (12) a test helper for writing assertions that print diagnostic information on failure.
